title: Website performance
goal: Measure a loading or interaction problem before changing code.
explanation: Performance includes loading, responsiveness and visual stability. Use developer tools and, when available, real-user measurements to find the actual bottleneck.
Serve appropriately sized images and reserve their dimensions to reduce layout shifts. Lazy-load suitable offscreen images, but do not blindly lazy-load the main hero image.
Reduce unnecessary JavaScript and expensive rendering work. Change one cause at a time, then measure again on a realistic device and connection.
exercise: Inspect a page with large images. Identify one oversized asset and reserve image dimensions.
hint: Measure before and after. Avoid treating a single lab score as the whole user experience.

quiz.question: Why declare image width and height?
options: To reserve layout space while it loads
quiz.explanation: Known dimensions help the browser reserve space and reduce unexpected movement.
